data.title: 矢来美羽 · 书架间的停留
data.description: 休日的书店里，她从架上抽出一本书，翻到夹着书签的那一页。
data.action: holding an open book beside a bookshelf
data.promptProse: Standing in a quiet, narrow aisle of an old-fashioned harbor town bookshop, vampire girl Miu holds an open novel near a tall cedar bookshelf, completely absorbed in the story. Slanting afternoon sunbeams filter through a dusty clerestory window, catching the golden highlights in her silver hair and illuminating floating dust specks and stacks of secondhand paperbacks.
